content.text:
# 🤯 OMG — Oh My GitHub ### 🚀 One Prompt In. A Full Game or App Out. 🚀 [![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-🔥%20works-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![GitHub Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/denaidark/OhMyGithub?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/issues) [![GitHub Actions](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub%20Actions-automated-2088FF?style=for-the-badge&logo=githubactions&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![OpenCode](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered%20by-OpenCode-111111?style=for-the-badge)](https://opencode.ai/) ```text ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ DESCRIBE IT → BUILD IT → TEST IT → PLAY IT ║ ║ ║ ║ One GitHub issue. One prompt. A complete project. ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝ ``` **No API keys to configure. No server to maintain. No local setup maze.**
--- ## 🤯 What Is OMG? > **Your GitHub issue becomes the product brief.** OMG (Oh My GitHub) is an automated GitHub Actions workflow for creating complete browser games and app projects from one natural-language prompt. Write what you want in an issue and add the `OpenCode` label. OpenCode checks out the project, uses the shared skills, builds the experience, runs tests, verifies the result, and publishes an immutable OmGithub project link from the finished commit. Yes, it creates the code. Yes, it runs the verification loop. Yes, it can expose the result in a temporary browser URL. ## 🧠 TL;DR 1. Open a GitHub issue. 2. Describe the game or app you want. 3. Add the `OpenCode` label to the issue. 4. Let GitHub Actions build, test, verify, and propose the result. ```text Your idea → GitHub issue → OpenCode → tests → immutable OmGithub project ``` ## ⚡ Quick Start Create an issue in your repository with a concrete request: ```text Build a neon asteroid game. Requirements: - Arrow-key movement - Score and restart button - Win and lose states - Responsive browser layout - Run tests and verify it in a browser ``` That is the whole user-facing workflow. GitHub Actions handles the runner, OpenCode handles implementation, and the workflow handles verification plus the immutable project commit. To run against an existing non-default branch, end the issue title with a `branch: ` directive. The directive selects the checkout and is removed before the issue body is sent to OpenCode: ```sh gh issue create \ --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub \ --title "Custom branch smoke test branch: codex/omgithub-site" \ --body "Build a tiny browser page." \ --label Goal \ --label OpenCode ``` The GitHub App validates the branch before dispatching. If the directive is absent, the repository default branch remains the target. ## 🌍 What Can You Build? | 🎯 Use case | ✨ Example | |---|---| | 🎮 Arcade games | Breakout, Space Invaders, Asteroids, Match-3 | | 🧩 Puzzle games | Word games, logic puzzles, card games | | 🏃 Interactive demos | Physics experiments, simulations, visual toys | | 📊 Dashboards | Filters, charts, status panels, analytics views | | 🛠️ Internal tools | Trackers, generators, small workflow apps | | 🌐 Landing pages | Product pages, portfolios, interactive showcases | | 🧪 Prototypes | Turn a product idea into a runnable proof of concept | | 📱 Browser apps | Responsive tools that work on desktop and mobile | ## 🧰 What Happens Automatically? > **The workflow is the product.** - 📥 Checks out your repository and the shared OpenCode skills. - 🏷️ Synchronizes `model/*` and `skill/*` labels. - 🧭 Reads issue labels to select the model and requested skills. - 🤖 Runs OpenCode against the current project. - 🧪 Runs a second verification prompt after implementation. - 🌐 Starts the app and checks the local runtime. - 🔗 Creates a temporary public preview URL when verification passes. - 🔀 Creates and pushes an `opencode/` branch. - 🕹️ Adds an `Open Project` link backed by the repository path, with full-commit links retained for compatibility. - 💬 Posts progress and access details back to the issue. - 🧹 Cleans up temporary tunnels and runner processes. ## 🏷️ Model and Skill Labels Labels let you control the workflow without editing YAML. ```text model/opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free skill/load-sketchfab-threejs skill/gauntlet-loop ``` The workflow validates the selected labels, passes them into OpenCode, and records the resolved model and skills in the run logs. Shared skills are discovered from: ```text .agents/skills//SKILL.md ``` ## 🔄 OpenCode Workflow ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Trigger] --> B[Prepare project] B --> C[Run build.md] C --> D[Run verify.md] D --> E{Public app works?} E -- No --> F[Run public-app-fix.md] F --> E E -- Yes --> G[Run completion-report.md] G --> H{Screenshots exist?} H -- No --> I[Run screenshot-evidence.md] I --> H H -- Yes --> J[Commit and push] J --> K[Create immutable project link] K --> L[Publish report] L --> M[Complete] ``` ## 🏗️ Architecture ```text ┌──────────────┐ ┌─────────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ │ GitHub issue │ ──▶ │ GitHub Actions │ ──▶ │ OpenCode │ │ + issue text │ │ runner + labels │ │ + .agents │ └──────────────┘ └─────────────────┘ └──────┬───────┘ │ ┌─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┐ ▼ ▼ ▼ Build code Run tests Verify app │ │ │ └─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┘ ▼ ┌────────────────────────┐ │ Commit store + preview │ └────────────────────────┘ ``` ## 🔐 Security and Access - 🔑 You do not need to create or store a project-specific AI API key. - 🖥️ You do not need to operate a dedicated build server. - ☁️ Execution happens in GitHub Actions. - 🔒 Temporary SSH and preview access exists only for the workflow run. - 👀 Review the generated commit before integrating it. - 🛡️ Restrict who can apply the `OpenCode` label in repositories that accept public issues. > “No servers needed” means no servers for you to provision or maintain. The workflow still uses GitHub-hosted Actions infrastructure and temporary workflow services. ## 📁 Project Structure ```text 📦 OMG ├─ .github/workflows/opencode.yml # 🤖 Main issue-to-project workflow ├─ wiki/opencode.md # 📖 Workflow and session notes ├─ wiki/testing.md # 🧪 Verification guidance └─ AGENTS.md # 🧭 Repository instructions ``` ## 🧪 Local Validation Validate the workflow definition before pushing changes: ```sh actionlint .github/workflows/opencode.yml git diff --check ``` ## 🐛 Troubleshooting | Problem | What to check | |---|---| | The workflow did not start | Confirm the `OpenCode` label is applied to the issue. | | A skill was not selected | Add a matching `skill/` label. | | The app URL is missing | Check the local app verification step and runner log. | | The PR was not created | Confirm OpenCode produced a diff and the workflow reached the PR step. | | The workflow ran unexpectedly | Tighten the trigger condition and trusted-user policy. | ## 🤝 Contributing Ideas, skills, game templates, verification improvements, and workflow fixes are welcome. 1. Open an issue describing the improvement. 2. Add the `OpenCode` label when you want the workflow to prototype it. 3. Review the generated commit and Open Project page carefully. 4. Add tests and runtime proof for workflow changes. ## ⭐ The Pitch The old workflow was: idea → tickets → scaffolding → setup → implementation → debugging → deployment.

## Game concept

**KOR LABİRENTİ** (Ember Labyrinth) — 2D turn-based puzzle game. Turkish UI.

Story: You are a "kıvılcım" (spark) in a dark labyrinth. Each level is a handcrafted grid. Collect all "kor" (embers) to awaken the exit "ocak" (hearth) and escape. Every move is one turn. Some tiles:
- Wall (#)
- Floor (.)
- Ember (*) — collectible
- Exit (E) — opens when all embers collected
- Cracked tile (~) — crumbles after you leave it? One-time floor.
- Ice (I) — slide until wall/obstacle, collecting embers along the way. Counts as one turn.
- Portal (P) — pair; stepping teleports to the other portal (counts as one turn).
- Gate (G) / Key (K) — collect key to open gates.
- Spike (^) — toggles on/off each turn? Maybe "alev" (flame) that is active every other turn, deterministic. Stepping on active flame = fail/reset. Adds turn-timing puzzle. But complexity for level design.
- Switch (S) / door (D) — step on switch to toggle doors. Turn-based puzzle.
- Mirror? no.

## Visual design

Aim for a premium, atmospheric 2D game:
- Dark teal/indigo background with warm amber accents. "Kor" (ember) glow.
- Layout: left side game board (canvas or DOM grid), right side HUD/leaderboard panel. On mobile, stacked with leaderboard below.
- Canvas rendering with devicePixelRatio, smooth animations, particles, glow, screen shake, tile transitions. Use a 2D canvas for the board, DOM for UI.
- Isometric-ish? A top-down grid with 2.5D depth (tiles drawn as rounded squares with extrusion and shadows) can look great. Use canvas transforms: draw each tile as a top face with a small side face; subtle perspective. But hit-testing and responsiveness need care. Simpler: top-down with thick bevels, glowing embers, animated fog, and a vignette. Add a slight parallax/scale.
- Board sizes 7x7 to 11x9. Responsive: canvas fits container, cell size computed.

- Compute BFS distances from start; exit = farthest open cell.
- Embers: choose cells with distance from start and exit, e.g., top 40% distance, not start/exit, at least 2 apart. Count = 3 + floor(levelIndex/2), capped 6.
- Compute optimal route: BFS distances between all points (start, embers, exit) on the maze (ignoring features). ### Week calculation

Use ISO week in UTC:
```
function getIsoWeek(date) {
  const d = new Date(Date.UTC(date.getUTCFullYear(), date.getUTCMonth(), date.getUTCDate()));
  const day = d.getUTCDay() || 7;
  d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 4 - day);
  const yearStart = new Date(Date.UTC(d.getUTCFullYear(),0,1));
  const week = Math.ceil((((d - yearStart)/86400000)+1)/7);
  return {year: d.getUTCFullYear(), week};
}
```

export class AudioEngine {
  constructor({ muted = false } = {}) {
    this.ctx = null
    this.master = null
    this.ambient = null
    this.muted = Boolean(muted)
    this.initialized = false
  }

  ensure() {
    if (this.initialized) {
      if (this.ctx?.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume().catch(() => {})
      return this.ctx
    }
    const Ctor = globalThis.AudioContext || globalThis.webkitAudioContext
    if (!Ctor) return null
    this.ctx = new Ctor()
    this.master = this.ctx.createGain()
    this.master.gain.value = this.muted ? 0 : 0.55
    const compressor = this.ctx.createDynamicsCompressor()
    compressor.threshold.value = -18
    compressor.knee.value = 20
    compressor.ratio.value = 4
    this.master.connect(compressor)
    compressor.connect(this.ctx.destination)
    this.initialized = true
    this.startAmbient()
    return this.ctx
  }

  setMuted(muted) {
    this.muted = Boolean(muted)
    if (this.master) {
      const now = this.ctx.currentTime
      this.masterInformation?.gain?.cancelScheduledValues?.(now)
      this.master.gain.cancelScheduledValues(now)
      this.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(this.muted ? 0 : 0.55, now, 0.08)
    }
  }

  toggle() {
    this.setMuted(!this.muted)
    return this.muted
  }

  startAmbient() {
    if (!this.ctx || this.ambient) return
    const ctx = this.ctx
    const bus = ctx.createGain()
    bus.gain.value = 0.55
    const filter = ctx.createBiquadFilter()
    filter.type = 'lowpass'
    filter.frequency.value = 220
    filter.Q.value = 0.7
    bus.connect(filter)
    filter.connect(this.master)

    const low = ctx.createOscillator()
    low.type = 'sine'
    low.frequency.value = 55
    const lowGain = ctx.createGain()
    lowGain.gain.value = 0.035
    low.connect(lowGain)
    lowGain.connect(bus)
    low.start()

    const high = ctx.createOscillator()
    high.type = 'triangle'
    high.frequency.value = 82.5
    const highGain = ctx.createGain()
    highGain.gain.value = 0.018
    high.connect(highGain)
    highGain.connect(bus)
    high.start()

    const lfo = ctx.createOscillator()
    lfo.type = 'sine'
    lfo.frequency.value = 0.055
    const lfoGain = ctx.createGain()
    lfoGain.gain.value = 70
    lfo.connect(lfoGain)
    lfoGain.connect(filter.frequency)
    lfo.start()

    // A quiet, filtered noise bed gives the stone room some air.
    const length = ctx.sampleRate * 2
    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, length, ctx.sampleRate)
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0)
    let last = 0
    for (let i = 0; i < length; i++) {
      const white = Math.random() * 2 - 1
      last = last * 0.96 + white * 0.04
      data[i] = last
    }
    const noise = ctx.createBufferSource()
    noise.buffer = buffer
    noise.loop = true
    const noiseFilter = ctx.createBiquadFilter()
    noiseFilter.type = 'bandpass'
    noiseFilter.frequency.value = 420
    noiseFilter.Q.value = 0.8
    const noiseGain = ctx.createGain()
    noiseGain.gain.value = 0.02
    noise.connect(noiseFilter)
    noiseFilter.connect(noiseGain)
    noiseGain.connect(bus)
    noise.start()

    this.ambient = { low, high, lfo, noise, bus, filter }
  }

  tone({ freq = 440, to = null, duration = 0.12, type = 'sine', gain = 0.1, delay = 0 }) {
    if (!this.ctx || this.muted) return
    const ctx = this.ctx
    const start = ctx.currentTime + delay
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator()
    const env = ctx.createGain()
    osc.type = type
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, start)
    if (to) osc.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(20, to), start + duration)
    env.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, start)
    env.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(gain, start + 0.012)
    env.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, start + duration)
    osc.connect(env)
    env.connect(this.master)
    osc.start(start)
    osc.stop(start + duration + 0.03)
  }

  play(name, options = {}) {
    if (!this.ctx || this.muted) return
    switch (name) {
      case 'move':
        this.tone({ freq: 210, to: 170, duration: 0.07, type: 'triangle', gain: 0.055 })
        break
      case 'bump':
        this.tone({ freq: 105, to: 70, duration: 0.09, type: 'square', gain: 0.045 })
        break
      case 'ember': {
        const chain = Math.max(0, options.chain || 0)
        const pitch = 1 + Math.min(6, chain) * 0.07
        this.tone({ freq: 660 * pitch, duration: 0.18, type: 'sine', gain: 0.085 })
        this.tone({ freq: 990 * pitch, duration: 0.24, type: 'sine', gain: 0.04, delay: 0.035 })
        this.tone({ freq: 1320 * pitch, duration: 0.16, type: 'triangle', gain: 0.025, delay: 0.06 })
        break
      }
      case 'key':
        this.tone({ freq: 880, duration: 0.12, type: 'triangle', gain: 0.06 })
        this.tone({ freq: 1320, duration: 0.2, type: 'sine', gain: 0.04, delay: 0.06 })
        break
      case 'portal':
        this.tone({ freq: 300, to: 1250, duration: 0.24, type: 'sine', gain: 0.05 })
        this.tone({ freq: 600, to: 240, duration: 0.3, type: 'triangle', gain: 0.035, delay: 0.02 })
        break
      case 'undo':
        this.tone({ freq: 330, to: 220, duration: 0.11, type: 'triangle', gain: 0.04 })
        break
      case 'death':
        this.tone({ freq: 180, to: 45, duration: 0.55, type: 'sawtooth', gain: 0.07 })
        this.tone({ freq: 90, to: 35, duration: 0.6, type: 'square', gain: 0.035, delay: 0.02 })
        break
      case 'win':
        ;[523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5].forEach((freq, index) => {
          this.tone({ freq, duration: 0.3, type: 'sine', gain: 0.07, delay: index * 0.09 })
        })
        this.tone({ freq: 261.63, duration: 0.8, type: 'triangle', gain: 0.03, delay: 0.1 })
        break
      case 'click':
        this.tone({ freq: 420, to: 380, duration: 0.04, type: 'triangle', gain: 0.03 })
        break
      case 'select':
        this.tone({ freq: 520, duration: 0.06, type: 'sine', gain: 0.035 })
        break
      default:
        break
    }
  }
}

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a polished 2D turn-based puzzle game with scoring and a weekly online leaderboard, per the Turkish request: "2d sıra tabanlı oyun yap bulmaca çözme ve puan yürütme ustüne olsun ve haftalık en yüksek sıralamali sekilde bir online sıra olsun".

## Requirements
- 2D turn-based gameplay focused on puzzle solving and score.
- Weekly highest-score online leaderboard with reset each week.
- Responsive browser game for desktop and mobile.
- Turkish UI.

## Decisions
- Game concept: **Kor Labirenti** — grid-based turn puzzle; collect embers (`*`), unlock and reach exit (`E`); mechanics: ice, portals, cracked floors, flame gates, keys/gates, patrolling sentries.
- Weekly format: 5 deterministic levels selected from a validated 108-level pool, transformed by seeded rotation/reflection; 3 cans per run; score submitted to a weekly leaderboard.
- Campaign: 12 fixed generated levels with increasing mechanics and intros.
- Online backend: public MQTT brokers via retained messages, primary `wss://broker.hivemq.com:8884/mqtt`, fallback `wss://broker.emqx.io:8084/mqtt`; topic namespace `korlabirent/v1/season/<weekId>/scores/<playerId>`; local storage fallback and pending queue.
- Weekly leaderboard includes 7 deterministic “ghost” benchmark entries, clearly labeled as reference rivals.
- Static HTML/CSS/ES modules; no root `package.json` because the OMGithub runtime rejects unsupported package projects.
- Use vendored `mqtt.min.js`, local Cinzel/Manrope fonts, procedural canvas visuals, and WebAudio-generated sound.
- ISO week in UTC, reset Monday 00:00 UTC.

## Work State
### Completed
- Core rules engine `src/rules.mjs` with parse/create/step/wait/undo-ready state, ice, portals, cracked tiles, flame gates, keys/gates, sentries, BFS solver, scoring.
- Deterministic generator `src/generator.mjs` and build script `scripts/build-levels.mjs`.
- Generated data committed locally: `src/data/campaign.mjs` (12 levels) and `src/data/weekly-pool.mjs` (108 levels).
- Season/week logic and weekly selection/transform in `src/season.mjs`.
- Tests in `tests/rules.test.mjs`; all 14 tests pass via `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`.
- Storage helpers `src/storage.mjs`.
- Game session controller `src/game.mjs`.
- Leaderboard client `src/leaderboard.mjs` with MQTT, ghosts, caching, pending submissions.
- Audio engine `src/audio.mjs`.
- Canvas renderer `src/renderer.mjs`.
- `index.html` created with full UI skeleton and intro overlay.
- Fonts copied to `assets/fonts/`; MQTT vendored at `src/vendor/mqtt.min.js`.
- KVdb/jsonblob/rentry experiments were done and rejected; MQTT retained messages selected and tested from Node.

### Active
- Writing `styles.css` (not yet created) and `src/main.mjs` (not yet created) to wire UI, renderer, game, leaderboard, modals, keyboard/touch controls, campaign level select, name editing, score submission, and weekly rollover.
- Need to verify MQTT works in a real browser, including the UMD bundle exposing `window.mqtt`.

### Blocked
- None currently, but MQTT browser compatibility and public broker reliability remain unverified.

## Next Move
1. Create `styles.css` implementing the full responsive visual design for the existing `index.html` structure.
2. Create `src/main.mjs` to initialize `Game`, `BoardRenderer`, `Leaderboard`, `AudioEngine`, load campaign/weekly data, wire all buttons/keys/swipes, render HUD/leaderboard, and handle modals/toasts.
3. Add leaderboard unit tests for `makeGhosts`, `parseRemoteEntry`, and merge/ranking behavior.
4. Start the app with `./start.sh` (or runtime server), use Playwright to verify desktop/mobile screenshots and actual gameplay, and confirm `aria-label="Play"` auto-start works with the capture script.
5. Verify online score publish/read across two browser contexts using the MQTT broker.
6. Fix any visual/gameplay issues found, rerun tests, and confirm no console/page errors.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: complete DOM/UI skeleton; expects `styles.css` and `src/main.mjs`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/rules.mjs`: canonical game rules, solver, scoring.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/game.mjs`: run/session controller and event emitter.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/leaderboard.mjs`: MQTT weekly leaderboard, ghosts, local fallback.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/renderer.mjs`: canvas board renderer and touch/swipe handling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/season.mjs`: ISO week info, weekly level selection/transforms.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.mjs`: WebAudio ambience/SFX.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/storage.mjs`: localStorage profile/scores/campaign/settings.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data/campaign.mjs`: 12 campaign levels.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data/weekly-pool.mjs`: 108 validated weekly levels.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/tests/rules.test.mjs`: current test suite.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/generator.mjs`: generator, not needed at runtime but useful for regeneration.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/scripts/build-levels.mjs`: regenerates campaign/weekly data.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/assets/fonts/`: local Cinzel/Manrope WOFF2 fonts.

## Important Context
- Root must **not** contain `package.json`; the runtime’s `start.sh` only supports static `index.html` or Vite projects.
- Runtime capture auto-clicks a visible enabled button whose aria-label/text is exactly `Play` (or `Start`); the intro primary button intentionally has `aria-label="Play"`.

- Weekly cans: 3; death or manual restart costs one; at zero the run ends and can be submitted.

331:     const dt = Math.min(0.05, (time - (this.prevTime || time)) / 1000)
332:     this.prevTime = time
333:     for (const particle of this.particles) {
334:       particle.life += dt
335:       particle.x += particle.vx * dt * 60
336:       particle.y += particle.vy * dt * 60
337:       particle.vy += particle.gravity
338:       particle.vx *= 0.985
339:     }
340:     this.particles = this.particles.filter((particle) => particle.life < particle.maxLife)
341:     for (const trail of this.trail) trail.age += dt
342:     this.trail = this.trail.filter((trail) => trail.age < 0.5).slice(-14)
343:     if (this.flash > 0) this.flash = Math.max(0, this.flash - dt * 3)
344:     if (this.winGlow > 0) this.winGlow = Math.max(0, this.winGlow - dt * 0.55)
345:     for (const dust of this.dust) {
346:       dust.x += dust.vx * dt * 60
347:       dust.y += dust.vy * dt * 60
348:       if (dust.y < -0.05) dust.y = 1.05
349:       if (dust.x < -0.05) dust.x = 1.05
350:       if (dust.x > 1.05) dust.x = -0.05
351:     }
352:   }
353: 
354:   updateSprite() {
355:     const sprite = this.sprite
356:     if (!sprite.queue.length) return
357:     const speed = this.reducedMotion ? 0.25 : 0.075
358:     sprite.t += speed
359:     if (sprite.t >= 1) {
360:       sprite.r = sprite.toR
361:       sprite.c = sprite.toC
362:       sprite.queue.shift()
363:       if (sprite.queue.length) {
364:         sprite.fromR = sprite.r
365:         sprite.fromC = sprite.c
366:         sprite.toR = sprite.queue[0].r
367:         sprite.toC = sprite.queue[0].c
368:         sprite.t = 0
369:       } else {
370:         sprite.t = 1
371:       }
372:       this.trail.push({ r: sprite.r, c: sprite.c, age: 0 })
373:     }
374:   }
375: 
376:   cellCenter(r, c) {
377:     return {
378:       x: this.offsetX + (c + 0.5) * this.cell,
379:       y: this.offsetY + (r + 0.5) * this.cell,
380:     }
381:   }
382: 
383:   draw(time) {
384:     const ctx = this.ctx
385:     if (!this.level || !this.cell) return
386:     ctx.setTransform(this.dpr, 0, 0, this.dpr, 0, 0)
387:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, this.cssWidth, this.cssHeight)
388:     ctx.save()
389:     if (performance.now() < this.shakeUntil) {
390:       const amount = this.shakeStrength
391:       ctx.translate((Math.random() - 0.5) * amount, (Math.random() - 0.5) * amount)
392:     }
393: 
394:     this.drawBackdrop(time)
395:     this.ensureStatic()
396:     ctx.drawImage(this.staticCanvas, 0, 0, this.cssWidth, this.cssHeight)
397:     this.drawDynamic(time)
398: 
399:     if (this.flash > 0) {
400:       ctx.fillStyle = this.flashColor || 'rgba(255,70,80,0.25)'
401:       ctx.globalAlpha = this.flash * 0.7
402:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, this.cssWidth, this.cssHeight)
403:       ctx.globalAlpha = 1
404:     }
405:     if (this.winGlow > 0) {
406:       const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(
407:         this.offsetX + this.cell * this.level.width * 0.5,
408:         this.offsetY + this.cell * this.level.height * 0.5,
409:         0,
410:         this.offsetX + this.cell * this.level.width * 0.5,
411:         this.offsetY + this.cell * this.level.height * 0.5,
412:         this.cell * this.level.width * 0.75,
413:       )
414:       gradient.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,190,90,${0.14 * this.winGlow})`)
415:       gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,190,90,0)')
416:       ctx.fillStyle = gradient
417:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, this.cssWidth, this.cssHeight)
418:     }
419:     ctx.restore()
420:   }
421: 
422:   drawBackdrop(time) {
423:     const ctx = this.ctx
424:     const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(
425:       this.cssWidth * 0.5,
426:       this.cssHeight * 0.45,
427:       this.cell * 0.2,
428:       this.cssWidth * 0.5,
429:       this.cssHeight * 0.5,
430:       Math.max(this.cssWidth, this.cssHeight) * 0.8,
431:     )
432:     gradient.addColorStop(0, '#101c2a')
433:     gradient.addColorStop(0.55, '#0a121d')
434:     gradient.addColorStop(1, '#05080e')
435:     ctx.fillStyle = gradient
436:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, this.cssWidth, this.cssHeight)
437: 
438:     const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(
439:       this.cssWidth * 0.5,
440:       this.cssHeight * 0.35,
441:       0,
442:       this.cssWidth * 0.5,
443:       this.cssHeight * 0.35,
444:       this.cssWidth * 0.55,
445:     )
446:     glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,150,60,0.055)')
447:     glow.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(70,220,200,0.025)')
448:     glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)')
449:     ctx.fillStyle = glow
450:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, this.cssWidth, this.cssHeight)
451: 
452:     for (const dust of this.dust) {
453:       const alpha = dust.alpha * (0.55 + 0.45 * Math.sin(time * 0.0012 + dust.phase))
454:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,190,120,${alpha})`
455:       ctx.beginPath()
456:       ctx.arc(dust.x * this.cssWidth, dust.y * this.cssHeight, dust.size, 0, TAU)
457:       ctx.fill()
458:     }
459:   }
460: 
461:   ensureStatic() {
462:     const key = `${this.level.id || this.level.rows.join('')}|${this.state?.crumbled ?? 0}|${this.cssWidth}x${this.cssHeight}|${this.cell}`
463:     if (key === this.staticKey) return
464:     this.staticKey = key
465:     const ctx = this.staticCtx
466:     ctx.setTransform(this.dpr, 0, 0, this.dpr, 0, 0)
467:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, this.cssWidth, this.cssHeight)
468:     this.drawStatic(ctx)
469:   }
470: 
471:   drawStatic(ctx) {
472:     const { level, cell } = this
473:     const width = level.width
474:     const height = level.height
475:     // Floor bed
476:     roundRectPath(
477:       ctx,
478:       this.offsetX - cell * 0.16,
479:       this.offsetY - cell * 0.16,
480:       width * cell + cell * 0.32,
481:       height * cell + cell * 0.32,
482:       cell * 0.22,
483:     )
484:     ctx.fillStyle = '#05090f'
485:     ctx.fill()
486:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,180,90,0.12)'
487:     ctx.lineWidth = 1
488:     ctx.stroke()
489: 
490:     for (let r = 0; r < height; r++) {
491:       for (let c = 0; c < width; c++) {
492:         const index = r * width + c
493:         const ch = cellChar(level, index)
494:         if (ch === WALL) continue
495:         this.drawFloor(ctx, r, c, index, ch)
496:       }
497:     }
498:     for (let r = 0; r < height; r++) {
499:       for (let c = 0; c < width; c++) {
500:         const index = r * width + c
501:         if (cellChar(level, index) === WALL) this.drawWall(ctx, r, c)
502:       }
503:     }
504:     // Static accents that sit on top of the floor.
505:     for (let r = 0; r < height; r++) {
506:       for (let c = 0; c < width; c++) {
507:         const index = r * width + c
508:         const ch = cellChar(level, index)
509:         if (ch === ICE) this.drawIceBase(ctx, r, c)
510:         if (ch === CRACKED) {
511:           const bit = level.crackedIndex.get(index)
512:           const crumbled = bit !== undefined && (this.state.crumbled & (1 << bit))
513:           if (crumbled) this.drawHole(ctx, r, c)
514:           else this.drawCracks(ctx, r, c)
515:         }
516:         if (ch === EXIT) this.drawExitBase(ctx, r, c)
517:       }
518:     }
519: 
520:     // Corner marks
521:     const corners = [
522:       [this.offsetX - cell * 0.24, this.offsetY - cell * 0.24, 1, 1],
523:       [this.offsetX + width * cell + cell * 0.24, this.offsetY - cell * 0.24, -1, 1],
524:       [this.offsetX - cell * 0.24, this.offsetY + height * cell + cell * 0.24, 1, -1],
525:       [this.offsetX + width * cell + cell * 0.24, this.offsetY + height * cell + cell * 0.24, -1, -1],
526:     ]
527:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,177,88,0.5)'
528:     ctx.lineWidth = 2
529:     for (const [x, y, sx, sy] of corners) {
530:       ctx.beginPath()
531:       ctx.moveTo(x, y + sy * cell * 0.18)
532:       ctx.lineTo(x, y)
533:       ctx.lineTo(x + sx * cell * 0.18, y)
534:       ctx.stroke()
535:     }
536:   }
537: 
538:   drawFloor(ctx, r, c, index, ch) {
539:     const cell = this.cell
540:     const x = this.offsetX + c * cell
541:     const y = this.offsetY + r * cell
542:     const inset = Math.max(1, cell * 0.035)
543:     const size = cell - inset * 2
544:     const n = hash2(r, c)
545:     const warm = ch === START || ch === EXIT
546:     const top = warm ? 32 + n * 8 : 22 + n * 7
547:     const bottom = warm ? 20 + n * 6 : 14 + n * 5
548:     const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x, y + cell)
549:     gradient.addColorStop(0, `rgb(${top + 6},${top + 14},${top + 22})`)
550:     gradient.addColorStop(1, `rgb(${bottom},${bottom + 9},${bottom + 17})`)
551:     roundRectPath(ctx, x + inset, y + inset, size, size, cell * 0.14)
552:     ctx.fillStyle = gradient
553:     ctx.fill()
554:     ctx.strokeStyle = warm ? 'rgba(255,180,90,0.16)' : 'rgba(140,190,210,0.08)'
555:     ctx.lineWidth = 1
556:     ctx.stroke()
557: 
558:     // Stone speckles
559:     ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${0.018 + n * 0.02})`
560:     for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
561:       const hx = x + inset + ((hash2(r + i, c * 3 + i) * 0.78 + 0.1) * size)
562:       const hy = y + inset + ((hash2(r * 3 + i, c + i) * 0.78 + 0.1) * size)
563:       ctx.fillRect(hx, hy, 1.2, 1.2)
564:     }
565:     if (warm) {
566:       const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(x + cell / 2, y + cell / 2, 0, x + cell / 2, y + cell / 2, cell * 0.5)
567:       glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,175,80,0.08)')
568:       glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,175,80,0)')
569:       ctx.fillStyle = glow
570:       ctx.fillRect(x, y, cell, cell)
571:     }
572:   }
573: 
574:   drawWall(ctx, r, c) {
575:     const cell = this.cell
576:     const x = this.offsetX + c * cell
577:     const y = this.offsetY + r * cell
578:     const inset = Math.max(1, cell * 0.04)
579:     const size = cell - inset * 2
580:     const depth = cell * 0.18
581:     const n = hash2(r, c)
582:     // Side face
583:     roundRectPath(ctx, x + inset, y + inset + depth, size, size - depth, cell * 0.1)
584:     ctx.fillStyle = '#070b12'
585:     ctx.fill()
586:     // Top face
587:     const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x, y + cell)
588:     gradient.addColorStop(0, `rgb(${34 + n * 12},${47 + n * 12},${64 + n * 12})`)
589:     gradient.addColorStop(1, `rgb(${17 + n * 8},${25 + n * 8},${36 + n * 8})`)
590:     roundRectPath(ctx, x + inset, y + inset, size, size - depth, cell * 0.1)
591:     ctx.fillStyle = gradient
592:     ctx.fill()
593:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(160,205,225,0.11)'
594:     ctx.lineWidth = 1
595:     ctx.stroke()
596:     // Highlight
597:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(220,245,255,0.09)'
598:     ctx.beginPath()
599:     ctx.moveTo(x + inset + cell * 0.16, y + inset + 1)
600:     ctx.lineTo(x + inset + size - cell * 0.16, y + inset + 1)
601:     ctx.stroke()
602:     if (n > 0.72) {
603:       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,170,80,0.13)'
604:       ctx.beginPath()
605:       ctx.moveTo(x + cell * 0.32, y + cell * 0.34)
606:       ctx.lineTo(x + cell * 0.5, y + cell * 0.52)
607:       ctx.lineTo(x + cell * 0.43, y + cell * 0.66)
608:       ctx.stroke()
609:     }
610:   }
611: 
612:   drawIceBase(ctx, r, c) {
613:     const cell = this.cell
614:     const x = this.offsetX + c * cell
615:     const y = this.offsetY + r * cell
616:     const inset = cell * 0.09
617:     const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, y, x + cell, y + cell)
618:     gradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(90,235,255,0.22)')
619:     gradient.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(40,150,190,0.16)')
620:     gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(120,250,255,0.1)')
621:     roundRectPath(ctx, x + inset, y + inset, cell - inset * 2, cell - inset * 2, cell * 0.1)
622:     ctx.fillStyle = gradient
623:     ctx.fill()
624:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,250,255,0.32)'
625:     ctx.lineWidth = 1
626:     ctx.stroke()
627:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(220,255,255,0.2)'
628:     ctx.beginPath()
629:     ctx.moveTo(x + cell * 0.26, y + cell * 0.7)
630:     ctx.lineTo(x + cell * 0.44, y + cell * 0.3)
631:     ctx.lineTo(x + cell * 0.58, y + cell * 0.58)
632:     ctx.stroke()
633:   }
634: 
635:   drawCracks(ctx, r, c) {
636:     const cell = this.cell
637:     const x = this.offsetX + c * cell
638:     const y = this.offsetY + r * cell
639:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)'
640:     ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, cell * 0.03)
641:     ctx.beginPath()
642:     ctx.moveTo(x + cell * 0.25, y + cell * 0.3)
643:     ctx.lineTo(x + cell * 0.45, y + cell * 0.5)
644:     ctx.lineTo(x + cell * 0.38, y + cell * 0.72)
645:     ctx.moveTo(x + cell * 0.45, y + cell * 0.5)
646:     ctx.lineTo(x + cell * 0.72, y + cell * 0.42)
647:     ctx.lineTo(x + cell * 0.8, y + cell * 0.6)
648:     ctx.stroke()
649:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,170,80,0.12)'
650:     ctx.lineWidth = 1
651:     ctx.stroke()
652:   }
653: 
654:   drawHole(ctx, r, c) {
655:     const cell = this.cell
656:     const x = this.offsetX + c * cell
657:     const y = this.offsetY + r * cell
658:     const inset = cell * 0.1
659:     const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(x + cell / 2, y + cell / 2, 0, x + cell / 2, y + cell / 2, cell * 0.6)
660:     gradient.addColorStop(0, '#000000')
661:     gradient.addColorStop(0.7, '#03060b')
662:     gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(8,14,22,0.2)')
663:     roundRectPath(ctx, x + inset, y + inset, cell - inset * 2, cell - inset * 2, cell * 0.12)
664:     ctx.fillStyle = gradient
665:     ctx.fill()
666:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,170,80,0.14)'
667:     ctx.lineWidth = 1
668:     ctx.stroke()
669:   }
670: 
671:   drawExitBase(ctx, r, c) {
672:     const cell = this.cell
673:     const x = this.offsetX + c * cell
674:     const y = this.offsetY + r * cell
675:     ctx.save()
676:     ctx.translate(x + cell / 2, y + cell / 2)
677:     const w = cell * 0.54
678:     const h = cell * 0.68
679:     ctx.beginPath()
680:     ctx.moveTo(-w / 2, h / 2)
681:     ctx.lineTo(-w / 2, -h / 4)
682:     ctx.arc(0, -h / 4, w / 2, Math.PI, 0)
683:     ctx.lineTo(w / 2, h / 2)
684:     ctx.closePath()
685:     ctx.fillStyle = '#03060a'
686:     ctx.fill()
687:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,178,84,0.28)'
688:     ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, cell * 0.035)
689:     ctx.stroke()
690:     ctx.restore()
691:   }
692: 
693:   drawDynamic(time) {
694:     const ctx = this.ctx
695:     const { level, cell } = this
696:     const width = level.width
697:     const height = level.height
698:     const allEmbers = level.emberCells.length === 0 || this.state.embers === (1 << level.emberCells.length) - 1
699: 
700:     // Exit aura
701:     const ex = level.exit
702:     const er = Math.floor(ex / width)
703:     const ec = ex % width
704:     this.drawExit(ctx, er, ec, allEmbers, time)
705: 
706:     for (let r = 0; r < height; r++) {
707:       for (let c = 0; c < width; c++) {
708:         const index = r * width + c
709:         const ch = cellChar(level, index)
710:         if (ch === EMBER) {
711:           const bit = level.emberIndex.get(index)
712:           if (!(this.state.embers & (1 << bit))) this.drawEmber(ctx, r, c, index, time)
713:         } else if (ch === PORTAL_A || ch === PORTAL_B) {
714:           this.drawPortal(ctx, r, c, ch, time)
715:         } else if (ch === FLAME) {
716:           this.drawFlame(ctx, r, c, time)
717:         } else if (ch === KEY) {
718:           if (!this.state.key) this.drawKey(ctx, r, c, time)
719:         } else if (ch === GATE) {
720:           this.drawGate(ctx, r, c, this.state.key, time)
721:         }
722:       }
723:     }
724: 
725:     // Patrol hints under sentries
726:     for (const sentry of level.sentries) {
727:       for (const index of sentry.path) {
728:         const r = Math.floor(index / width)
729:         const c = index % width
730:         const x = this.offsetX + (c + 0.5) * cell
731:         const y = this.offsetY + (r + 0.5) * cell
732:         ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,80,90,0.14)'
733:         ctx.beginPath()
734:         ctx.arc(x, y, Math.max(1.2, cell * 0.045), 0, TAU)
735:         ctx.fill()
736:       }
737:     }
738:     for (const sentry of level.sentries) {
739:       const index = sentryPosition(sentry, this.state.turn)
740:       const r = Math.floor(index / width)
741:       const c = index % width
742:       this.drawSentry(ctx, r, c, time)
743:     }
744: 
745:     this.drawPlayer(ctx, time)
746:     this.drawParticles(ctx)
747:     if (this.hover && this.state.status === 'playing') {
748:       const { r, c } = this.hover
749:       const x = this.offsetX + c * cell
750:       const y = this.offsetY + r * cell
751:       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,200,120,0.45)'
752:       ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
753:       roundRectPath(ctx, x + cell * 0.06, y + cell * 0.06, cell * 0.88, cell * 0.88, cell * 0.14)
754:       ctx.stroke()
755:     }
756:   }
757: 
758:   drawEmber(ctx, r, c, index, time) {
759:     const cell = this.cell
760:     const x = this.offsetX + (c + 0.5) * cell
761:     const y = this.offsetY + (r + 0.5) * cell
762:     const pulse = 0.85 + Math.sin(time * 0.004 + index) * 0.15
763:     const radius = cell * 0.14 * pulse
764:     const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, cell * 0.42)
765:     glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,230,160,0.55)')
766:     glow.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(255,150,60,0.26)')
767:     glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,120,40,0)')
768:     ctx.fillStyle = glow
769:     ctx.beginPath()
770:     ctx.arc(x, y, cell * 0.42, 0, TAU)
771:     ctx.fill()
772:     const core = ctx.createRadialGradient(x - radius * 0.2, y - radius * 0.3, 0, x, y, radius * 1.4)
773:     core.addColorStop(0, '#fffdf2')
774:     core.addColorStop(0.35, '#ffd479')
775:     core.addColorStop(1, '#ff7b1f')
776:     ctx.fillStyle = core
777:     ctx.beginPath()
778:     ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, TAU)
779:     ctx.fill()
780:     // four-point glint
781:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,245,210,0.75)'
782:     ctx.lineWidth = 1
783:     ctx.beginPath()
784:     ctx.moveTo(x - radius * 2.1, y)
785:     ctx.lineTo(x + radius * 2.1, y)
786:     ctx.moveTo(x, y - radius * 2.1)
787:     ctx.lineTo(x, y + radius * 2.1)
788:     ctx.stroke()
789:   }
790: 
791:   drawExit(ctx, r, c, open, time) {
792:     const cell = this.cell
793:     const x = this.offsetX + (c + 0.5) * cell
794:     const y = this.offsetY + (r + 0.5) * cell
795:     if (!open) {
796:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,150,60,0.25)'
797:       ctx.beginPath()
798:       ctx.arc(x, y, cell * 0.06, 0, TAU)
799:       ctx.fill()
800:       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,180,90,0.18)'
801:       ctx.lineWidth = 1
802:       ctx.beginPath()
803:       ctx.arc(x, y, cell * 0.24, 0, TAU)
804:       ctx.stroke()
805:       return
806:     }
807:     const pulse = 0.8 + Math.sin(time * 0.0035) * 0.2
808:     const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, cell * 0.65)
809:     glow.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255,220,150,${0.7 * pulse})`)
810:     glow.addColorStop(0.35, `rgba(255,150,60,${0.35 * pulse})`)
811:     glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,120,40,0)')
812:     ctx.fillStyle = glow
813:     ctx.beginPath()
814:     ctx.arc(x, y, cell * 0.65, 0, TAU)
815:     ctx.fill()
816:     ctx.save()
817:     ctx.translate(x, y)
818:     ctx.rotate(time * 0.0005)
819:     ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,225,170,0.85)'
820:     ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1.2, cell * 0.035)
821:     for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
822:       ctx.beginPath()
823:       ctx.arc(0, 0, cell * (0.22 + i * 0.055), i * 2.1, i * 2.1 + 1.7)
824:       ctx.stroke()
825:     }

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {

## Objective
- Build a polished 2D turn-based puzzle game with scoring and a weekly online leaderboard, per the Turkish request: "2d sıra tabanlı oyun yap bulmaca çözme ve puan yürütme ustüne olsun ve haftalık en yüksek sıralamali sekilde bir online sıra olsun".

## Requirements
- 2D turn-based gameplay focused on puzzle solving and score.
- Weekly highest-score online leaderboard with reset each week.
- Responsive browser game for desktop and mobile.
- Turkish UI.

## Decisions
- Game concept: **Kor Labirenti** — grid-based turn puzzle; collect embers (`*`), unlock and reach exit (`E`); mechanics: ice, portals, cracked floors, flame gates, keys/gates, patrolling sentries.
- Weekly format: 5 deterministic levels selected from a validated 108-level pool, transformed by seeded rotation/reflection; 3 cans per run; score submitted to a weekly leaderboard.
- Campaign: 12 fixed generated levels with increasing mechanics and intros.
- Online backend: public MQTT brokers via retained messages, primary `wss://broker.hivemq.com:8884/mqtt`, fallback `wss://broker.emqx.io:8084/mqtt`; topic namespace `korlabirent/v1/season/<weekId>/scores/<playerId>`; local storage fallback and pending queue.
- Weekly leaderboard includes 7 deterministic “ghost” benchmark entries, clearly labeled as reference rivals.
- Static HTML/CSS/ES modules; no root `package.json` because the OMGithub runtime rejects unsupported package projects.
- Use vendored `mqtt.min.js`, local Cinzel/Manrope fonts, procedural canvas visuals, and WebAudio-generated sound.
- ISO week in UTC, reset Monday 00:00 UTC.
- All runtime source files renamed from `.mjs` to `.js` because the runtime static server serves `.mjs` as `application/octet-stream`, which browsers reject for module scripts. Node 22 auto-detects ESM in `.js`; tests still use `.mjs`.
- Intro Play starts weekly with `{ quiet: true }` so the auto-capture screenshot has no startup toast. Online-connect toast removed; net chip is sufficient.
- Final modal and campaign/name modals reopen each other safely via `onClose`/`onDone` callbacks; actions that open another modal avoid closing the new modal via activeModal identity checks.
- Own leaderboard entry is merged first so local name changes override stale cached copies with equal score.

## Work State
### Completed
- Core rules engine `src/rules.js` with parse/create/step/wait/undo-ready state, ice, portals, cracked tiles, flame gates, keys/gates, sentries, BFS solver, scoring.
- Deterministic generator `src/generator.js` and build script `scripts/build-levels.js`.
- Generated data: `src/data/campaign.js` (12 levels) and `src/data/weekly-pool.js` (108 levels).
- Season/week logic and weekly selection/transform in `src/season.js`.
- Tests in `tests/rules.test.mjs`; all 14 tests pass via `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`.
- Storage helpers `src/storage.js`.
- Game session controller `src/game.js`; campaign chapter index bug fixed by restoring `run.index` after `startLevel(0)`.
- Leaderboard client `src/leaderboard.js` with MQTT, ghosts, caching, pending submissions; own-entry merge order fixed.
- Audio engine `src/audio.js`.
- Canvas renderer `src/renderer.js`.
- Full UI skeleton in `index.html`; script now points to `src/main.js`.
- `styles.css` created with complete responsive dark ember theme, desktop/mobile layouts, modal/toast styling, dpad, campaign grid, help/name/result screens.
- `src/main.js` created and wired: game initialization, weekly/campaign flows, HUD, renderer events, keyboard/WASD/tap/swipe/dpad controls, restart/undo, death/win/final modals, campaign select/progress, name editing, help, sound, season countdown/rollover, leaderboard tabs and online status.
- Fixed arrow-key handling (`event.key.toLowerCase()`), campaign index UI sync, final HUD cans update, zero-score final subtitle, result-rank line wrapping, mobile topbar/dpad/board sizing, and leaderboard list height.
- Desktop and mobile screenshots captured in `screenshots/`: intro, gameplay, win modal, final modal, campaign modal, death modal.
- Verified full weekly run (score 5.835, rank #1), campaign level 1 win/progress/next-level index `02 / 12`, restart/can loss to zero, death/retry, and name editing.
- Verified MQTT online publish/read across a fresh browser context: retained score `KorUstası 5.835` appeared with no console errors.
- Retained test score was cleared from HiveMQ by publishing an empty retained payload to topic `korlabirent/v1/season/2026-W44/scores/7fe6911c-0480-4c4a-94c4-dba3ebb6ea77`.

### Active
- Final verification pass: confirm clean capture after clearing retained score, test remaining UI flows if desired, and inspect final desktop/mobile screenshots.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Reload and verify the leaderboard returns to ghosts-only after clearing the retained test score.
2. Run `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` and `node --check src/*.js` once more.
3. Optionally add unit tests for `makeGhosts`, `parseRemoteEntry`, and leaderboard merge/ranking behavior.
4. Re-run `./capture.sh` or equivalent Playwright capture at desktop/mobile and inspect final screenshots for regressions.
5. Commit all uncommitted files in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround` once verification passes.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: full DOM/UI skeleton; loads `styles.css` and `src/main.js`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: all UI wiring, flows, modals, input, leaderboard/campaign integration.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: complete responsive visual design.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/rules.js`: canonical game rules, solver, scoring.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/game.js`: run/session controller and event emitter.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/leaderboard.js`: MQTT weekly leaderboard, ghosts, local fallback, merge/ranking.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/renderer.js`: canvas board renderer and touch/swipe handling.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/season.js`: ISO week info, weekly level selection/transforms.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: WebAudio ambience/SFX.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/storage.js`: localStorage profile/scores/campaign/settings.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data/campaign.js`: 12 campaign levels.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data/weekly-pool.js`: 108 validated weekly levels.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/tests/rules.test.mjs`: current test suite.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: captured desktop/mobile screenshots for review.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/vendor/mqtt.min.js`: browser MQTT UMD bundle exposing `window.mqtt`.

## Important Context
- Root must **not** contain `package.json`; runtime supports static `index.html` or Vite projects.
- Runtime static server lacks `.mjs` MIME mapping; all app modules must remain `.js`.
- Runtime capture auto-clicks a visible enabled button whose aria-label/text is exactly `Play`; intro primary button has `aria-label="Play"`.
- MQTT is confirmed working in Chromium: fresh context read retained score and reported `Çevrimiçi` / `Canlı sıralama`.
- Weekly scoring: base 300 + 75/ember + 30/move under par + 200 on-par + 40/max chain + 150 perfect + undo penalties; weekly total subtracts 50/death.
- Weekly cans: 3; death or manual restart costs one; at zero run ends and final modal appears.
- Campaign progress stored under `korlabirent.v1.campaign`; campaign best scores update on win and unlock next level.
- Name editing updates `korlabirent.v1.profile` and republishes own score if connected.
- Current git state: all project files are uncommitted/untracked in `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`.
- Local preview currently runs via tmux session `kor` on `PORT=3002` using `./start.sh`; server responds HTTP 200.
